# Pearson Building

> Pearson Building is a bespoke building company based in Bellingdon, near Chesham, Buckinghamshire. It designs, builds and manages extensions, interiors, restorations and new-build family homes, with in-house craftsmen producing kitchens, bathrooms and fitted furniture.

- Address: Highmead Yard, Bellingdon, Bucks, HP5 2XU
- Telephone: 01494 758799
- Areas covered: Chesham, Amersham, Gerrards Cross, High Wycombe, Marlow, Bourne End, Wooburn and the surrounding area
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/PearsonBuilding/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/): overview of services and featured projects
- [Project videos](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/project-videos): video walkthroughs of completed projects, including Castle Hill and Wiggington new builds
- [Castle Hill new build](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/castle-hill-new-build): four-storey, five-bedroom family home with a bespoke metal and glass staircase
- [Tanners Farm House](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/tanners-farm-house): complete refurbishment of a 250-year-old property, completed in 7 months
- [Phelps](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/phelps): client testimonial for a new family home build
- [Contact](https://www.pearsonbuilding.co.uk/contact): telephone and address
